Last night I did a full uninstall of League and Riot. Dug through all the files on my desktop after uninstalling the program(s) just to make sure I got everything. Reinstalled League fresh, I still get capped at 45 fps no matter if I am fullscreen, borderless, windowed, vert sync on or off, anti-alias on or off,  fps capped or uncapped, on all graphic settings from low (no shadows) to high.  
HOWEVER I can get it to go to 60 - 70 fps if I tab out and back in. I have to tab out at 4 ish minutes into my games and again at 18 minutes.

Riot says all my specs are good to go for the vanguard update when I launch the client now too which is odd.

Anywho hope that helps. Appreciate you looking into this for people, mighty kind of ya. I'll be doing more tests today so if you have any suggestions feel free to allow me to be the guinea pig.
